name: uber-rest-implementation
description: Local ride-booking SOA demo: Rides, Marketplace and Payments APIs, a durable worker, and a Next.js rider app on LocalStack.

scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix rides-api && npm ci --prefix marketplace-api && npm ci --prefix payments-api && npm ci --prefix load-simulator && npm ci --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix rides-api && npm run build --prefix marketplace-api && npm run build --prefix payments-api && npm run build --prefix load-simulator
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix rides-api && npm run typecheck --prefix marketplace-api && npm run typecheck --prefix payments-api && npm run typecheck --prefix load-simulator && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend
scripts.analytics:replay: npm run build --prefix rides-api && node --env-file-if-exists=.env rides-api/dist/scripts/replay.js
